data.title: Airport Link faces temporary extension
data.description: The current operator of the Airport Rail Link may continue running the service after its memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) expires on Sept 30, said Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) Office secretary-general Chula Sukmanop.

data.title: Campus feud sparks talks
data.description: Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat said he would meet police and deans from two rival campuses after students clashed again at Siam BTS station.

data.title: Ekkapob named new govt spokesman
data.description: The cabinet approved the appointment of Dr Ekkapob Pianpises as a government spokesman yesterday, according to deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana.

data.title: KL renews peace talks support
data.description: Malaysia has reaffirmed its commitment to work with Thailand to resolve the long-running southern insurgency, Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

data.title: Blacklist targets civil service cheats
data.description: The government is tightening measures against cheating in civil service examinations, including a nationwide blacklist of offenders and plans to make the General Examination a fully electronic exam within three years.

data.title: Abhisit grills govt on Land Bridge study
data.description: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has questioned why the government has continued funding a feasibility study of the controversial Land Bridge project, despite the Finance Ministry acknowledging concerns about its economic viability.

data.title: Navy moves ahead  with frigate plan
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy is moving ahead with its frigate procurement project after the permanent secretary for defence approved the selection result, stressing that the project must deliver benefits to Thailand beyond simply acquiring a new warship.

data.title: Real Madrid win Champions League opener as Haaland stars for Man City
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Jose Mourinho got off to a winning start on his return to the Champions League with Real Madrid on Tuesday as the Spanish giants beat Inter Milan 2-1, while Erling Haaland scored twice in Manchester City's victory at Porto.

data.title: Mums demand answers on death
data.description: Two mothers have sought help from the Pavena Foundation for Children and Women over a 17-year-old girl's death following an alleged assault at a rehabilitation centre in Lampang.

data.title: Phuket MP faces 3rd summons
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has summoned People's Party MP for Phuket Somchart Techathavorncharoen to meet investigators next Monday in an inquiry into alleged foreign nominee arrangements.

data.title: Chinese boxing promoter in legal victory
data.description: The Appeal Court on Tuesday acquitted a Chinese boxing promoter of human trafficking charges, citing inconsistencies and doubts in the evidence against him.

data.title: Thailand, Brazil push for stronger economic ties
data.description: Thailand and Brazil are seeking to deepen their partnership as diplomatic relations approach their 70th anniversary, with trade and investment high on the agenda.

data.title: BJT fears renewed turmoil
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) has hit back at former activist leader Sondhi Limthongkul, warning that renewed street protests could drag Thailand back 20 years and undermine investor confidence.

data.title: Sri Lankan workers get nod
data.description: The government recently approved two memoranda of understanding (MOUs) on labour cooperation between Thailand and Sri Lanka, paving the way for the legal employment of 10,000 Sri Lankan workers in Thailand.

data.title: Thai students below OECD PISA average
data.description: Thai students' performance in science, mathematics, reading and computational problem solving remains below the OECD average, according to PISA 2025 results released on Tuesday.

data.title: Govt defends bid to eject Frenchman
data.description: The Interior Ministry has defended its deportation order against French national Kevin Dimino, citing his alleged threats to public order and social harmony.

data.title: Netanyahu under fire over report UAE warned of October 7 attack
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli opposition leaders on Tuesday called Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu unfit to serve after a bombshell report that the United Arab Emirates had warned him before the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack.

data.title: NY failed to disclose what it knew on 'toxic air' after 9/11
data.description: NEW YORK - New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced on Tuesday the release of tens of thousands of documents showing the city did not disclose all it knew about air toxicity after 9/11.

data.title: Nearly 1,100 flights cancelled after UK air traffic control glitch
data.description: LONDON - Almost 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled Tuesday due to what the country's air traffic control service called a technical issue, in the latest glitch to spark travel chaos.

data.title: Gambian leader vows power boost after violent blackout protests
data.description: BANJUL (GAMBIA) - Gambian President Adama Barrow on Tuesday pledged to boost power supplies by next month after violent protests over blackouts that have dogged the west African country since June.

data.title: Hong Kong's first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa dies aged 89
data.description: HONG KONG - Hong Kong's first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa has died aged 89, his office said Wednesday.

data.title: World Cup final scorer Torres leads Ballon d'Or nominees
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Ferran Torres, whose goal against Argentina won the World Cup for Spain in July, leads a 30-man list for the men's Ballon d'Or revealed on Tuesday.

data.title: Trump and Putin hold ‘constructive’ phone call
data.description: MOSCOW — Russian President ​Vladimir Putin and ​US President Donald ‌Trump had a “constructive and frank” hour-long telephone call during which ​Trump ⁠stressed his wish for the ‌war in Ukraine to end as soon as ⁠possible, a Kremlin aide said on Tuesday.

data.title: Spain releasing intelligence reports into Ceuta migrant rush
data.description: MADRID - The Spanish government on Tuesday declassified intelligence reports about July’s migrant surge into its north African enclave Ceuta in a bid to quell doubts about what it knew beforehand and the potential role of Morocco.

data.title: UK, France and Canada sanction Israeli settlers
data.description: LONDON - Britain on Tuesday announced a trade ban on goods made in Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank in coordination with France and Canada, the latest sanctions to target Israel as it faces growing diplomatic isolation.

data.title: French far right silent on AfD triumph in Germany
data.description: PARIS - The French far right has kept a guarded silence over the far-right Alternative for Germany’s (AfD) triumph in regional elections, wary that too close an association with the party could harm Marine Le Pen’s chances in France’s 2027 presidential vote.

data.title: Lebanon town buries its dead after Israeli strike
data.description: KFAR RUMMAN, Lebanon - Hundreds of people in south Lebanon gathered on Tuesday to mourn two Hezbollah members and their family, among them a three-month-old infant, killed by an Israeli strike a day prior.

data.title: Nicaragua accuses Germany of complicity in Gaza genocide
data.description: THE HAGUE - Nicaragua accused Germany of "multiple violations of international law" at the United Nations top court on Tuesday, as it pressed its case that Berlin is complicit in what it described as genocide in Gaza.

data.title: Thai clinic linked to penile-filler fatality investigated
data.description: Thai public health officials have opened an investigation into the death of a British influencer who died after receiving a penile filler injection at a clinic in Pathumwan district of Bangkok in March.

data.title: Thaivivat Unveils AI Crash-Detection System as Profits Surge 102%
data.description: Thaivivat Insurance marks 75 years with an AI crash-detection launch, as parent Thaivivat Holdings posts 102% profit growth and eyes double-digit growth

data.title: Nicaragua accuses Germany of multiple violations of law in Gaza genocide case
data.description: THE HAGUE - Nicaragua accused Germany of "multiple violations of international law" at the United Nations top court on Tuesday, as it pressed its case that Berlin is complicit in what it described as genocide in Gaza.

data.title: On London's Brick Lane, a data centre sparks local battle
data.description: LONDON - In Brick Lane, the historic heart of London’s Bangladeshi community, residents oppose plans for a data centre in a disused brewery, citing the erosion of heritage and need for social housing.

data.title: Nepal flood death toll rises as rescuers scour tunnels
data.description: KATHMANDU - The death toll from Nepal's devastating flood rose on Tuesday to 1,357, with 5,326 people still missing, the country's disaster authority said nearly two weeks after the August 26 disaster.

data.title: Thieves steal Renoir paintings from France museum
data.description: CAGNES-SUR-MER - Thieves on Tuesday stole four Renoir paintings worth millions of US dollars from a museum in southern France, but abandoned two as they fled, a mayor said.
